g1a_requirements: download or otherwise materialize the exact model.safetensors bytes bound below
verify SHA-256 and byte count before deserialization
instantiate the exact model under timm==1.0.26 with pretrained=False and load the verified upstream state strictly
apply the normalization-equivalence patch-embedding transform before classifier reset
prove numerical parity against the unmodified upstream model fed its native-normalized input under the v1.2.1 evidence-backed float32 gate
reset only the 1000-way classifier to 120 classes under the frozen S1/S2/S3 seed
persist and hash a separate deterministic initialization object for each seed

normalization_equivalence.purpose: Preserve the pretrained model's initial patch-embedding function up to expected float32 convolution/normalization rounding while all CropCop candidates receive the common CTC-v2 normalized tensor.
normalization_equivalence.scope: patch_embed.proj only, before seeded classifier reset
normalization_equivalence.zero_or_absent_bias_rule: If patch_embed.proj has no bias, an equivalent bias parameter must not be invented silently. Qualification must fail closed and the amendment must be revised before science.

parity_gate.inputs: at least 32 deterministic RGB tensors spanning constant colors, gradients, seeded random values and 8 prediction-blind DS-V1-VAL images
parity_gate.metric: max absolute difference between native-normalization patch-embedding outputs and CTC-normalization/equivalence-transformed patch-embedding outputs in float32
parity_gate.calibration_rule: The new bound must remain above the independently reproduced exact-pretrained maximum 3.4332275390625e-05 and may not be changed after science starts without a new versioned amendment.
